title: devx(pin-citations): objectui line anchors in `packages/spec` records outside `check:objectui-pin-citations`' population are never re-measured on a pin bump, and some now point at moved or wrong lines
body:
Filed by the director seat, summon #32 (`session_016tKoy8NJa35Yih1FdzrVmn`), holder of #21772's claim `5986229732`. Source: the at-tier contract review of PR #21800 (`5986881331`, ③), which escalated this as having no carrier, and the dev report `5986773912` (out-of-scope note 3). ⛔ Not a claim. Routing and grading are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` pin lane (the owner of `check:objectui-pin-citations` and `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`).

## The gap

- `check:objectui-pin-citations` re-measures only the asserting citation form, the one that names `.objectui-sha`'s current sha.
- Records written in the historical form ("the `.objectui-sha` pin X", dated reads) are outside its population. A pin bump never re-measures them, even when they cite objectui files the bump changed.
- PR #21800 (pin `2e818d0b51ec` → `9dfaca654311`) re-pointed every asserting citation. The review found dated reads at `2e818d0b51ec` that cite files changed in that range:
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` about `:3578`, `:4968`, `:6306`, `:7029`, `:8186` and `:8653`;
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.ledger.ts` about `:452` and `:479`;
  - the files they cite include `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `types/src/data-display.ts`, `containers.tsx` and `plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx`.
- **One anchor is already wrong:** `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts` about `:4146` cites `plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:204`, which is a lone closing brace at both pins. It predates PR #21800.

These are still true as dated statements, but a reader following one lands on a moved or wrong line, and nothing detects the drift.

## Direction to judge

Pick one:
- **(a)** Bring the historical form into the gate's population, so a bump flags every record whose cited file changed in the range.
- **(b)** Re-point the listed anchors once, and make the bump tooling report them as "cited file changed in range; re-read".

Fix the `component.test.ts` anchor either way.
